text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day during break, I happen to see
Narita Brian speaking with
another
student.

text_block_list.name: Friendly Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
So, like,
I have some friends who're fans of
yours too, and we wanna
go to karaoke
with you sometime—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm busy. Go ask someone else.

text_block_list.name: Friendly Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that interaction reminds me of
when I first met her.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: There's nothing to talk about.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Scram.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even now, we don't speak much outside of
training. Maybe we'd
understand each
other better if we could talk a little
more...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No need. You're my trainer—nothing more,
nothing less.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Conversation over. Let's start training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What good would that do?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Just think about it. Why get involved in
other people's lives?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I never expected you to get to know me.
You don't need to
understand my
motivation.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
All you need to know is that I want to
run.
Help me do that, and we're
good.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The whole time she's saying this, she's
staring off into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to see anyone's fire go out
anymore, much less extinguish
it myself.
I'm... sick of it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her hunger for racing may not be
something that can be sated in a
single
lifetime.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No matter where I go, no matter who I
challenge, it's always the same.
I'm left
feeling hungrier than before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She must have been suffering this
lonesome burden for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's not enough. I need more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her drive will never be satisfied no
matter
how many opponents she
faces.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian will always have to contend
with this unceasing desire in
her heart.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That's enough. Talking more won't get me
anywhere. Let's drop this
pointless discu—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You really...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh. Fine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Don't expect me to like it,
though. I'm still
going to do what I want.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Simple as that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Well,
no need to rush... We'll take it slow
and build up our rapport
from there.
